# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 76 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 76 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_076_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Part 3 — The Rejected Stones and the Virgins

**76:1** Some stones brought up from the deep were placed in the building and fit perfectly with the ones from the plain — they were brilliantly bright. But some others brought by the men didn't fit into the structure at all. They were set off to the side near the tower, unusable. The reason? They hadn't received the seal. All the usable stones had the seal of the virgins.

**76:2** "Who are these virgins?" I asked the shepherd. "They are holy spirits," he said. "There's no other way into the kingdom of God — you have to be clothed by them. If you get the name but don't receive their garment, it does you no good. These virgins are the Powers of the Son of God. If you carry the name but not the power, you're carrying the name for nothing."

**76:3** "What about the rejected stones — who do they represent?" I asked. "Those," he said, "are the people who received the name but never put on the virgins' garment." "What is their garment, lord?" I asked. "The names themselves are the garment," he said. "Anyone who carries the name of the Son of God needs to carry the names of these virgins too. The Son of God himself carries the names of these virgins."

**76:4** "And the stones thrown far from the tower that landed on the road and then rolled off into the rough ground — who are they?" "Those," he said, "are people who believed, but then gave up the true road because of their double-mindedness. They thought there was a better road somewhere else, went looking for it, got lost, and ended up suffering out there in the rough terrain."

**76:5** "What about the ones that fell into the fire and burned — who are they?" "Those," he said, "are the ones who completely walked away from the living God. Repentance never even crossed their minds anymore — they were too far gone into lust and wicked behavior."

**76:6** "And who are those that fell near the water but couldn't make it into the water?" "Those," he said, "are people who heard the word and wanted to be baptized in the name of the Lord. But then when they remembered what purity and truth actually required, they backed away and went right back to their evil desires."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, making the rejected stone typology and the virgins-as-Powers doctrine of Similitude 9 vivid and comprehensible.*
